notes: application_valid is separate from training artifact validity
support=0 means not trainable for supervised acceptance

fall_detection.reason: Accepted Fall Expert Core no-UMAFall already demonstrates strong label support and stable metrics.

ppg_quality.reason: Accepted binary good/bad quality gate already has strong supervision and strong deployment value.

activity_context_current.reason: Current mixed task is trainable but not ideal. ADL supervision is effectively single-source and mixed with source-heavy normal/instability windows.

activity_v2_pure_adl.reason: Pure ADL target is viable, but needs broader true posture/activity data beyond UCI-HAR. PAMAP2 is the main addition candidate.

vitals_context_current.reason: poor_signal support is zero, abnormal_trend has no supervised examples, and the current checkpoint is source-confounded.

vitals_load_v2.reason: A binary normal_load/elevated_load task is plausible if WESAD target mapping is repaired and handcrafted runtime-compatible features are exported.

gait_instability_current.reason: Raw DAPHNET freeze labels exist, but they are lost in canonical mapping/export. Support must be recounted after rescue.

tremor_context.reason: Only 138 windows are present and the task is already explicitly disabled for supervised training.
